[color=#4CAF50][b]What's New[/b][/color]
• Navigate Backwards: use your Android back button or ESC key to go back on any screen or dialog box
• Pick your Theme: choose Light, Dark, or Adaptive theme from Settings
• Always On: toggle carousel auto-start when you open the app or reboot your device
• Long-press any image to enter Multi-select mode
• Faster image import with direct file picker + better Android 15 support
• Export wallpapers with a confirmation dialog, no more accidental exports

[color=#4CAF50][b]Improvements[/b][/color]
• Smoother multi-select and better touch handling
• Light theme colors now display correctly throughout the app

[color=#4CAF50][b]Fixes[/b][/color]
• Some apps could not receive shared images
• Dialog boxes no longer let touches pass through in multi-select mode
• Collapsed groups no longer expand when you change columns
• Random wallpaper selection picks the right images now
• Multi-select header no longer overlaps the scroll area
• Share button no longer gets stuck on the preview screen
• Interval input now uses the numpad keyboard
